text: [VAR 0100(0000)].\c\nPrepare yourself, for I shall now use my psychic\npowers to Teleport you to the top with me![VAR 0114(0072)]
That was a truly elegant battle, wouldn’t you\nagree, [VAR 0100(0000)]?\c\nI am trusting you to continue in this elegant vein.[VAR 0114(0072)]

My Future Sight told me that we would come
this far together!\c
Now, let us bear witness to what is yet to come
as well![VAR 0114(0072)]
You really knew what you were doing when you\nchose me as a partner, didn’t you? Hee hee!\c\nLet’s melt down our rivals into itty-bitty pieces![VAR 0114(0071)]

You know, you and me make a better combo
than I would’ve expected!\c
If you like, maybe we can keep teaming up
even after the competition, too.[VAR 0114(0071)]
I’m so excited that my whole body’s shaking...\c\n[VAR 0100(0000)]! We’re gonna rip victory away\nfrom the competition, you hear?![VAR 0114(0071)]
Woo-hoo! I can’t believe little ol’ me gets to\nbattle alongside Champion [VAR 0100(0000)]!\r\nLet’s have some fun until we’ve won![VAR 0114(0073)]
Just what I’ve come to expect from you!\nYou’re just the sort of student I can entrust all\r\nmy secrets to—even my secret game exploits![VAR 0114(0073)]
We’ve finally reached the tippy-top!\c\nLet’s have the time of our lives giving all the\nspectators in the stadium the time of their lives![VAR 0114(0073)]

Hey, Chief!
I’ve gotta say—I’m chuffed you chose me!\c
Not sure if I can keep up with a Champ like you,
but I’ll try not to hold you back! Gahahaaa![VAR 0114(0076)]

That first match went off without a hitch!
Let’s roll right over ’em in round two, too.\c
My darlin’ Nia said she’d come watch, so I’ve
gotta make sure she sees her papa at his best![VAR 0114(0076)]

No surprises there, eh?
You and me, we’re a match made in legend!\c
Let’s keep it turned up to a hundred till
we’ve seen this all the way through,
Chief [VAR 0100(0000)]![VAR 0114(0076)]

[VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
With you and me battling side by side, we’re sure
to be the greatest thing Galar has ever seen!\c
Let’s ensure everyone has a good time by making
this the greatest tournament ever![VAR 0114(0004)]

I’m seeing even greater strength from you than
you’ve shown me before, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
I was so pumped up that I nearly had Charizard
attack your team by accident![VAR 0114(0004)]

Looks like we’ve reached the pinnacle of our
champion time together!\c
[VAR 0100(0000)]!
This is it! The greatest final match ever![VAR 0114(0004)]
Seriously? Wasn’t there anyone else willing to\npartner with you?[VAR 0114(000C)]
At least you won’t hold me back in battle, like\nmost of these other Trainers would have done.[VAR 0114(000C)]
The final match, is it?\c\nIt doesn’t really matter, though. Winning with you\nat my side won’t prove my strength to anyone.[VAR 0114(000C)]
Thanks for choosin’ me for this tournament.\c\nMorpeko seems real pleased to get to battle\nalongside your team, too.[VAR 0114(000D)]

I’ve been workin’ on really polishin’ up my skills
lately, since I’m a Gym Leader now an’ all that.\c
I won’t let you steal the spotlight this whole
battle, even if you are the Champion![VAR 0114(000D)]

I’m really lookin’ forward to gettin’ to share this
win with you.\c
That’s why there’s no way we’re losin’ here in the
final round![VAR 0114(000D)]

It’s quite the honor, getting handpicked by the
reigning Champion.\c
So let’s have a great time together, taking it
nice and slow.[VAR 0114(000E)]

Everyone out here is really strong.
I guess I can’t let my guard down just yet!\c
But I’m not too worried. No matter who I’m up
against, I’ve got you with me, [VAR 0100(0000)].[VAR 0114(000E)]
We’re finally here at the end.\c\nLet’s throw everything we’ve got at our last\nopponents and bowl ’em over![VAR 0114(000E)]

I’ve got to admit, it feels a bit strange teaming
up together with you like this.\c
I mean...I’m happy to get to battle alongside
you, but you’re just too good. You know?[VAR 0114(000F)]

What did you think of our graceful Water-type
moves? I’ve worked to refine them to their
purest form.\c
I’ll be firing them off from beside you in the next
match, too.[VAR 0114(000F)]
When you and I team up together, there’s no way\nwe can do anything but win.\r\nSo once you’re ready, let’s go and do just that.[VAR 0114(000F)]

[VAR 0100(0000)]! You are both my partner and
my rival in this contest!\c
I will expend my strength as much as I am able to
at your side—while learning from your example![VAR 0114(0010)]
That last battle raged hotter than even flame.\c\nBut we can’t be reduced to ash just yet.\nWe need to burn even brighter before it’s over![VAR 0114(0010)]

The flames of my strength... They have been
fanned by your wind, Champion [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
Having made it this far, there is nowhere left for
us to go but the very top![VAR 0114(0010)]

Wantin’ to pair up with someone like me...
I won’t pretend like I know what you’re up to.\c
Dynamaxin’ my Pokémon’s still off the table,
but I’ll do whatever else I can in this battle.[VAR 0114(0016)]
I’m not even a Gym Leader anymore or anything.\nBut thanks to you, it seems like I’m still gettin’ in\r\nplenty of tough battles, huh?[VAR 0114(0016)]

Well. Looks like we made it all the way to
the end.\c
So what? Nothing to worry about.
This’ll be a walk in the park for you and me.[VAR 0114(0016)]

This...is...brilliant! You and me, kid... We’re
gonna be the greatest tag team in history.\c
I feel a bit sorry for the others. They don’t even
stand a chance—because we’re sure to win this![VAR 0114(0017)]

Anyone facing off against the great Raihan and
[VAR 0100(0000)] is done for!\c
And no need to worry—I’m recording the whole
thing with my Rotom Phone to post later.\c
Speaking of which... Try to smile a bit more in
the next match, would you?[VAR 0114(0017)]

Naturally we blew right past the second round!\c
You really are something, [VAR 0100(0000)]...
There aren’t many who can keep up with me.\c
When we win, we’ve definitely got to snag a
sweet selfie together to commemorate this![VAR 0114(0017)]
Thank you very much for inviting me to join you.\c\nI will use all my skill to try to live up to your\nexpectations, so let us begin at once.[VAR 0114(0011)]

One has to be careful not to let a single victory
lull oneself into complacency.\c
But at the same time, being able to battle with
you... It feels so right and...comfortable.[VAR 0114(0011)]

We finally face our greatest challenge, which will
decide whether we taste victory or defeat.\c
Let us do our best to align our moves and attacks
even better than we ever have before![VAR 0114(0011)]

You may be the Champion and all, but I don’t
plan to sit back and let that decide this match.\c
I’m going to show everyone the brilliance of the
Rock type—in that sense, I’ll even beat you.[VAR 0114(0014)]

That last battle... Well, you conducted yourself
just as I would have expected, Champion.\c
If you hadn’t, you wouldn’t have been worthy as
my partner.[VAR 0114(0014)]

Hah... So we come to the end at last.\c
Be careful you don’t slip up. All it takes is one
pitfall for a battle to end in disaster.
Let’s finish this up before it comes to that.[VAR 0114(0014)]
A...are you really sure you wanted m-me to be\nyour partner?[VAR 0114(0012)]
Umm... Let’s...er...let’s do it again![VAR 0114(0012)]

[VAR 0100(0000)]...\c
L...
L...
Let’s win this tourney![VAR 0114(0012)]

Looks like someone needs to chill. You want the
power of my ice to slide to victory?\c
Don’t worry—we’ll have these weak opponents
trembling before us![VAR 0114(0015)]

Just what I expected of you, Champion!
This is going to be fun, battling with you.\c
Let’s bring the temperature down even lower.
I won’t lose here, so take care you don’t freeze![VAR 0114(0015)]

You’ve done well, battling so many times in a
row. One more match till we win the whole
thing! You sure you have it in you?\c
I won’t let you live it down if you drop the ball
because you’re too tired![VAR 0114(0015)]

Well, well, well, well, WELL!
Young M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)]!
What an honor to have been chosen by you.
I am gratitude personified, as you can
surely see!\c
Anyone fool enough to take on a pair of
celebrities such as ourselves shall soon be
tasting our dust as we outstrip them![VAR 0114(0068)]

How very like you, your glorious Champion-ness!
No matter where you go, there are none who
can stand up to your majesty!\c
I wonder whether my earnest but incomparable
team has been any help to you at all.[VAR 0114(0068)]

Only one step remains for us to take before
victory lies within our hands!\c
When you consider yourself ready, let us bring
this tournament to a glorious finale![VAR 0114(0068)]

Well, well, well, well, WELL!
Young M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)]!
It is an honor to have been chosen by you.
I am terribly indebted to you for this boon.\c
Just you wait and see—I will prove to you that I
am just as capable a battler even when not
paired with my older brother!\c
Because that is what a true celebrity does![VAR 0114(0069)]

I am all aflutter with delight at being able to
share such a victory with you, young
M[VAR 1100(00FF,0205)]asters. [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
It seems it was worth all the training we put in as
we toured the region apologizing for our
celebrity-scale misdeeds![VAR 0114(0069)]

The final round is all that awaits us now!
Our victory is practically assured!\c
Fate has made us a sweet promise, and she surely
will not betray us now!\c
It will pain my heart slightly to seize a victory
such as none my older brother shall ever
grasp...yet a true celebrity never lets such
feelings show![VAR 0114(0069)]

[VAR 0100(0000)]!
Thanks for calling me, mate.\c
I know I’ve been spending all my days hitting the
books, but I think it’s actually taught me more
about battling, too!\c
Let’s make this a tournament that’ll bring smiles
of delight to everyone’s faces![VAR 0114(0005)]

That’s our Champion of Galar for you!\c
You’ve gotten even stronger since the last time
we battled, haven’t you?\c
To think that I got to learn and battle alongside
someone like you, [VAR 0100(0000)]...\c
It’s really been the best thing in my life, and
nothing makes me prouder.[VAR 0114(0005)]

Here we are at the final round!\c
I’ll wring out every bit of strength I’ve got in me.\c
After all, it wouldn’t do to be the one to blame
for making Champion [VAR 0100(0000)] lose![VAR 0114(0005)]

I don’t have any intention of outstaying my
welcome, you understand.\c
But if you young ones insist that you need my
help, then I can hardly ignore your pleas.[VAR 0114(0013)]

Yes, yes, well done.
You seem to be coming along quite well.\c
You’re precisely what I’ve come to expect in a
Champion—even if you are sadly lacking in pink.
Let’s keep it up, and we’ll reach the top.[VAR 0114(0013)]

It’s obviously no fluke that you managed to
defeat that young Leon.\c
Even partnering up with a retired old woman like
myself isn’t slowing you down, is it?\c
Win this whole thing, and I’ll even offer you my
heartfelt congratulations.[VAR 0114(0013)]
